⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Reference to a position within an `AssetAudio`.

Used to place audio on the timeline and enable synchronized playback
with other data streams (video, sensors, detections).

Log these at timestamps where you want the audio to be "active" on the timeline.
The viewer will decode and play from the specified sample offset.

## Fields
### Required
* `sample_offset`: [`SampleOffset`](../components/sample_offset.md)

### Optional
* `duration_samples`: [`SampleCount`](../components/sample_count.md)


## Can be shown in
* [AudioView](../views/audio_view.md)
* [DataframeView](../views/dataframe_view.md)
